notes.title: Chapter 2: Second Half Update!
notes.notes:
Who smashed the window at Megan's house? What’s weighing on Kimmy’s mind? Can Bradok break free from his imprisonment? And what does Principal Stickland have in store for Hunter? All these questions (and more) will be answered in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135390/0b143e3f963886e7ceaa7c5ff5faaf41744403c1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Path Viewer Update!
notes.notes:
We're introducing the "Path Viewer". This new menu will allow you to replay scenes featuring a specific romantic interest (Currently Megan, Betty and Kimmy). As you play through the game, these scenes will unlock. Just load your latest save and look for the "Path Viewer" menu.

Replay the girls' key moments with the press of a button. Simply select a character and relive their story at any time!

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
It's now possible to automatically unlock the relationship paths with all the girls! This will work even after having passed the in-game choices that lead to these paths.

Just load your save file and press the "Unlock all paths" button on the game menu.
[i](Make sure to save your game after clicking this button).[/i]

notes.title: Clarification Regarding Recent Update
notes.notes:
We would like to clarify that the recent update is an extension of Chapter 1, not the release of Chapter 2 as was mistakenly communicated. Chapter 2 is currently in development and will feature a much larger content offering, including approximately 20 new scenes.

We apologize for any confusion caused and appreciate your understanding. We hope you continue to enjoy the extended content in Chapter 1!

- Mr. Mister team

notes.title: Chapter 1 Extension Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that the Chapter 1 Extension update of [i][b]Hunter: Space Pirates[/b][/i] is now available.

Continue your journey from where you left off at the end of Chapter 1, and dive deeper into the story with new characters that will to capture your attention. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to further develop your relationship with Betty!

Thank you for your continued support – we can't wait to hear your thoughts. Jump back in and experience the next chapter today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135390/7c6553732647cedb2db523cbb35aabd0e236173a.png[/img]

notes.title: Chapter 1 Extension Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We wanted to inform you that while Chapter 1 Extension was originally scheduled for release this weekend, we’ve encountered some unforeseen delays with Steam’s verification process, preventing us from going live as planned.

We are currently working to solve this issue. In the meantime, for those eagerly awaiting the update, we invite you to follow us on our socials to find other platforms where you can play the game!
